name_zh: 马斯里克/捷克/建国/一战/托马/总统/民主/布拉格/斯柯达
description_zh: 托马斯·马斯里克（1850-1937），捷克政治家，国家创立者，第一任总统，民主主义者，领导捷克斯洛伐克建国。
description_en: Tomas Masaryk (1850-1937), Czech politician, nation founder, first President, democratist, led Czech nation founding.
reason_zh: 马斯里克是国家创立者和第一任总统，其民主思想和建国实践对中欧民主产生深远影响。
reason_en: Masaryk was nation founder and first President, his democratic thinking and nation founding practice profoundly influenced Central European democracy.
intellectual_tradition: Democratic Nationalism / Nation Building / Presidential Leadership
cross_cultural_impact: Nation founding implementation; Czech democracy establishment; Central European democracy influence;
